🔴 MiniCheckers

Classic Checkers (Draughts): diagonal moves on dark squares, jump over opponent pieces to capture them. Free, no ads, no login — play instantly on Bytecade Games.

How to Play

  1. Move diagonally forward one square onto an empty dark square.
  2. Jump diagonally over an opponent's piece to capture it — landing on empty square.
  3. Multiple captures (chain jumps) are mandatory when available.
  4. Reach the opposite end to crown your piece as a King — Kings move backward.
  5. Capture all opponent pieces or block them so they can't move to win.
